phone.login: username is the account PHONE NUMBER (use main_user phone_number from the task header), not the email. Password: from supervisor.show_account_passwords for account 'phone'.
phone.search_contacts: Contacts have first_name,last_name,email,phone_number and `relationships` (a LIST like ['sibling','brother']). query = name/number search, relationship = filter (brother,coworker,father,friend,manager,mother,parent,roommate,sibling,sister,subordinate). page_limit<=20; page through.
phone.get_current_date_and_time: Takes NO arguments (no access_token). Returns {'date': 'Thursday, May 18, 2023', 'time': '09:26 PM'}. Use it for today/yesterday/this month; parse with parse_long_date().
venmo.login: username is the account EMAIL; password from supervisor passwords, account 'venmo'.
venmo.show_received_payment_requests: Items have payment_request_id, sender{name,email}, approved_at/denied_at (both None = pending); no 'status' field or request_id. Approve/deny/remind APIs take payment_request_id. Filter by sender email before acting; page_limit<=20.
venmo.create_payment_request: Takes user_email (the other person's email from phone contacts), amount, description, optional private. NOT receiver_email / note. Check the returned dict; an error text means no request was created.
venmo.create_transaction: Takes receiver_email, amount, optional description (leave it out unless the task gives text), payment_card_id, private. Without payment_card_id the Venmo balance is used. On 'expired'/'does not have $' errors try the next card from the cards list (usable_cards); never add made-up cards or top up the balance.
venmo.show_transactions: Filters: query, user_email, direction (sent|received), min/max_created_at 'YYYY-MM-DD', min/max_amount, private; page_limit<=20. Items: transaction_id, amount, created_at, sender{name,email}, receiver{name,email}. 'sent or received' = two calls.
spotify.show_song: PUBLIC: do not pass access_token. Gives play_count, release_date, genre, rating, like_count, album_id. Same for show_album, show_artist, search_songs/albums/artists, show_song_reviews.
spotify.show_song_privates: Only your liked/reviewed/in_song_library/downloaded flags; has NO play_count. Use show_song for play_count/rating.
spotify.show_playlist: access_token is optional but REQUIRED for private playlists (422 otherwise). No paging. Songs are in `songs` (each has `id`; there is NO song_ids here). Only library listings (show_playlist_library) give song_ids.
spotify.show_album: PUBLIC (no access_token). 'songs' list items use key 'id'. Library listings (show_album_library) give song_ids.
spotify.show_song_queue: No page_index. Items have song_id, position, is_current, is_playing. 'Played so far' = positions up to and including the item with is_current.
spotify.show_song_library: Items have song_id and added_at (when added to library), NOT release_date. Get release_date/play_count via show_song(song_id).
spotify.create_playlist: 409 if a playlist with that title exists: then find it with show_playlist_library(query=title) and reuse it.
file_system: Params: directory_path, file_path, source_file_path, destination_file_path, access_token. NOT path/source_path. os/io/open are blocked: build CSV text with to_csv. Date-based tasks: move_file(..., retain_dates=True). After writing/moving, re-read with show_file/show_directory to verify. Never delete or compress the directory you are working in unless asked.
file_system.show_directory: NO paging (do not pass page_index; call it directly, once). Params: directory_path, substring, entry_type (all|files|directories), recursive (DEFAULT True: lists nested files too). Returns ABSOLUTE paths; directories end with '/'. Print the listing before moving/deleting anything.
supervisor.show_account_passwords: Returns a list of {account_name, password}; use get_password(passwords, 'phone'/'venmo'/...) helper. Re-run it in your own code: variables from examples do not exist.
supervisor.complete_task: Call once at the end. Question tasks: answer=<bare value> (number for counts/sums, name/title only, no sentence). ACTION tasks (send, move, rate, follow, delete, create...): call complete_task() with NO answer argument; answer= makes the task fail.
spotify.show_liked_songs: Needs access_token. Items have song_id (not id). Page with page_limit=20 (default 5 truncates!) until an empty page. Same for show_song_library, show_album_library, show_playlist_library, show_following_artists.
venmo.search_users: FUZZY: returns a non-empty list for almost any query, no phone search. To check whether a person has an account, require an exact email match in the results (helper has_exact_email).
file_system.show_file: Returns {file_id, path, content, created_at, updated_at}; content is a string. Bills: the period is in the FILE NAME (name_ym), created_at lags a month; amount is the 'Total Amount => $N' line (labeled_amount); only .txt files.
file_system.compress_directory: Params: directory_path, compressed_file_path (a .tar.gz/.zip path), delete_directory (True removes the source), overwrite, access_token. Pass delete_directory=False unless the task says to remove the directory.
spotify.show_artist: PUBLIC (no access_token). The follower number is `follower_count` (there is no 'followers' key); print the dict to see other fields. show_song has artists=[{id,name,genre,follower_count}] (a LIST, songs can have several artists), genre, release_date, play_count, rating (global average).
spotify.search_artists: PUBLIC. Filters: genre=, min_follower_count=, query=; page_limit<=20. Print one item to see its id key before using it (do not assume .get('id') works); pick the artist by EXACT name equality, then verify a follow by re-reading show_following_artists (paged: fetch_all).
spotify.review_song: No rate_song API exists. review_song(song_id, rating, access_token) 409s if you already reviewed: then show_song_reviews(song_id, user_email=<your email>) gives review_id -> update_song_review(review_id, rating). Rating is 1-5.
spotify.like_song: 422 'already liked' means the goal state holds: treat as success. Same for follow_artist, download_song, add_song_to_library. Do not undo or redo.
spotify.show_current_song: Needs access_token. Returns song_id, title, album_id, duration, played_seconds, is_playing and artists=[{id,name}] (a LIST; no artist_id key). Take artists[0]['id'] (or all of them if several) and call show_artist(artist_id=) for follower_count.
spotify.show_playlist_library: Items have playlist_id, title, is_public, song_ids. Page with fetch_all (page_limit<=20). A playlist's duration = sum of its songs' duration (seconds, via show_song or show_playlist 'songs').
venmo.show_sent_payment_requests: MY outgoing requests ('my requests to X', 'did X pay me'). Counterparty = receiver{name,email}; pending = approved_at and denied_at both None. remind_payment_request(payment_request_id) re-notifies. Requests sent TO me: show_received_payment_requests. Page with fetch_all.
venmo.create_transaction_comment: Takes transaction_id and comment. like_transaction(transaction_id) likes. Find transactions with show_transactions(direction='sent'|'received', ...) or show_social_feed (paged) - filter by receiver/sender email, not name.
venmo.show_social_feed: Paged (page_limit<=20): fetch_all. Items are transactions of you and friends: transaction_id, sender{name,email}, receiver{name,email} (NO 'user' key), description, like_count. Counterparty = the side that is not me. like_transaction(transaction_id, access_token) needs the token.
phone.show_profile: show_profile(phone_number=<number>) finds a user (incl. their email) by phone number; use it to get an email for Venmo calls when you only have a number. search_contacts gives email for named contacts.
phone.search_text_messages: Params: query (matches message TEXT, not names), phone_number (one contact's thread), only_latest_per_contact, page_index, page_limit<=20. Items: sender/receiver{name,phone_number}, message, sent_at. Page with fetch_all; amounts_in(message). Resolve the contact first, then pass phone_number.
phone.send_text_message: send_text_message(phone_number, message): phone_number is digits of the contact (contact['phone_number']). show_text_message_window(phone_number, min_datetime, max_datetime, ...) reads one thread in a time window.
phone.show_alarms: PAGED: use fetch_all(apis.phone.show_alarms, access_token=tok); a single call returns only the first page. Alarm fields include alarm_id, time, days, enabled.
spotify.remove_song_from_library: Name is remove_song_from_library (not delete_song_from_library). Takes song_id, access_token. Same pattern: remove_album_from_library(album_id), remove_playlist_from_library. Check state first; only remove what the task names.
spotify.show_downloaded_songs: Paged (page_limit<=20): use fetch_all. Needs access_token. Items have song_id. Related: download_song / remove_downloaded_song take song_id.
spotify.search_songs: PUBLIC (no access_token). To list one artist's songs pass artist_id=<id> (query matches titles, not artist names); also genre, min/max filters. Page with fetch_all (page_limit<=20). Get artist_id from search_artists(query=name).
spotify.show_recommendations: Needs access_token. PAGED: use fetch_all(apis.<app>.show_recommendations, access_token=tok); a single call returns only 5 items. Items have song_id; look up details with show_song.
spotify.add_song_to_playlist: Takes playlist_id, song_id, access_token; ONE song per call (no add_songs_to_playlist). Read the playlist first (songs[].id) and skip songs already in it. 409/422 'already' = fine. Create the playlist only after you know the song list is non-empty.
spotify.show_liked_albums: Needs access_token; paged (page_limit<=20): use fetch_all. Items have album_id. like_album / unlike_album take album_id.
venmo.add_to_venmo_balance: Adds money from a card to your Venmo balance: do NOT use it unless the task says to top up. To pay with a card pass payment_card_id to create_transaction; on a 422 'does not have' error try the next non-expired card.
simple_note.search_notes: PAGED (default 5 per page!): use fetch_all(apis.<app>.search_notes, access_token=tok, query=...) to get every note. Returns titles/ids only, no content: call show_note(note_id) for content. query is a fuzzy text match: choose a note by EXACT title equality, never results[0].
simple_note.show_note: Returns note_id, title, content (string), tags. Print the content once before parsing. Indented ' - key: value' lines are details (e.g. director) of the item above, not items. Apply the task's qualifier (director, genre...) to those details; send titles only.
file_system.create_file: Params: file_path, content, overwrite (bool), access_token. No allow_if_exists (that is create_directory). Log in to file_system first (own token). Write, then re-read with show_file to confirm; expand '~' to the home path shown by show_directory.
file_system.move_file: Params: source_file_path, destination_file_path (a full path INCLUDING the file name), access_token, overwrite, retain_dates. Rename = move within the same directory. Plan all (old,new) pairs first, skip names already renamed, and run a bulk loop only after checking the first pair.
spotify.play_music: The play API is play_music (no play_song): takes song_id OR album_id OR playlist_id plus access_token. Afterwards confirm with show_current_song. Pick the target by reading the data (ties!), not by a guess.
spotify.show_song_reviews: PUBLIC (no access_token). Items have song_review_id, rating, user{email}. Filter user_email=<your email> to find your review, then update_song_review(review_id=<that song_review_id value>, rating=...): the PARAMETER is review_id.
spotify.delete_account: 'Terminate/close my account' = delete_account(access_token) (logout does not delete it). Do it LAST, only after every other step (e.g. the export file) is written and verified by a read-back.
spotify.update_song_review: Params: review_id (NOT song_review_id), rating, access_token. review_id = the song_review_id of an item from show_song_reviews. Only update when the new rating differs as the task requires.
file_system.login: file_system has its OWN login: username = my email, password = the file_system entry of show_account_passwords. Every file_system call needs the returned access_token (a string); None or another app's password gives 401.
spotify.show_liked_playlists: Needs access_token; paged: fetch_all. These are LIKED PLAYLISTS, not liked songs. 'Songs I liked' = show_liked_songs.
phone.delete_text_message: Takes text_message_id (the `text_message_id` / id field of the message item; print one message to see it), access_token. NOT message_id. Re-read the thread afterwards to confirm the count.
file_system.directory_exists: Returns a dict {'exists': bool}, which is ALWAYS truthy: test ['exists'], not the dict itself.
